s1a.selection_rule:
S1a map selection (CPU, before the lock; v1 train+dev, template 0 pooled states only).
Cyclic domains: every directed N-cycle (N <= 7) or 2000 random ones (N = 12, seed 3101); daysago: 2000 random path orders
(excluding the natural order and its reverse). sigma_max = largest E_iso; sigma_med = median (lower median; ties -> lexicographically
smallest). For Z4, sigma_med is dropped when it equals the natural cycle (either direction) or sigma_max.

training.l2_scale: per domain and op: mean train canonical write token MSE

definitions.one_way_R2N: R at step 2N of plus_from_start (cyclic); R_7 of plus_from_path_start (daysago)
definitions.single: success over all legal single transitions (template 0) x 160 worlds
definitions.probe: torch multinomial logistic regression, standardized slot vectors, C in {0.01,0.1,1,10} by 5-fold world CV (accuracy); see DEVIATIONS #1
definitions.writes: W(x) = M * (T(E(x)) - E(x)), plus operator, token level

G2_0.rule: natural RRR-16 one-way R_2N >= 0.95 in all five v1 domains AND C1 R_2 <= 0.20 for every domain x seed; otherwise stop

A2.quantity: RRR-16 one-way R_2N for every scrmax/scrmed map
A2.H_symN: Spearman rho(E_iso, R_2N) over all maps incl. natural <= -0.5 AND min R_2N < 0.95

A3.quantity: R_10N(natural) - R_10N(scrmax), RRR-16, four cyclic domains

Q1.rule: H-slot if A1, A2, A3 all H-slot; H-sym-N if A1 H-sym-N and at least one other domain scrmax RRR-16 R_2N <= 0.50; else partial

A4.quantity: max phase deviation of |lambda|>=0.9 eigenvalues, RRR-16 plus, natural and scrmax, cyclic domains

B1.quantity: pron3 and name3 RRR-16 one-way R_6

B3.quantity: C1 R_2 for pron3, name3, bind3, every seed

B4.note: measured before the lock on train+dev (as the plan specifies); value recorded below; not prospective

pre_lock_value.note: Observed before the lock (train+dev only, as the plan specifies); B4 is therefore not prospective.

Q2.rule: H-bind if B2 meets H-bind; H-geom if B2 meets H-geom; else neither

R1.rule: for each natural cyclic domain (weekday N=7, month 12, compass 4, egoside 4): r* = smallest grid rank with one-way R_2N >= 0.95 at it and all larger grid ranks; pass if N-2 <= r* <= N and the largest grid rank below r* (if any) has R_2N <= 0.20; R1 passes if all four pass

R2.rule: natural single-step success >= 0.95 at month rank 8 and weekday rank 4

R3.rule: single(natural) - single(scrmax) >= 0.20 at r = N-2 for weekday (5) and month (10); r*(scrmax) also reported

R4.rule: exploratory: harmonics present in the unit block at each rank

R5.rule: exploratory: first-failure transitions for daysago low ranks (boundary entry?)

M1.quantity: mean pairwise cosine of C1 writes across source states (world mean)

M2.quantity: cosine(C1 write, canonical write), per-world mean over sources, median over worlds

M3.quantity: probe readout on C1 first-step slot
M3.admissible_if: probe dev accuracy on canonical encodings >= 0.99

predictions.M_aggregation: each M statistic is computed per (domain, C1 seed) cell (15 cells); the hypothesis test uses the median over cells; all cells reported

Q4.rule: the hypothesis met by the majority of M1-M4 (ties -> mixed)

stop_rules: G2-0 fail -> stop and debug the pipeline
8 GPU h -> report; 10 GPU h -> stop
same job fails twice for unknown reason -> stop
